items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: And lucky Johnson was in front of me and Dave and them.

ctx.x: They were pretty rough in the channel, huh?

Oh, yeah, man. It was rough. Well, the Negroes were rough too, partner. Yeah, they was tough too. Dang, man. They had a girl there. They got broke out after me there. And she's going with a waking fellow there. You know what I mean? I didn't know, Dick. And there were about four of them that were going to kill me when we get in that night. We had played at St. Elizabeth Hall up there at Napoleon Avenue. And I'm coming in that night and they're all in the corner. But lucky Johnson was in front of me and Dave and…
